ai_context.heading: AI without context is guesswork.

ai_context.para3: Pzaz connects your full production context so your tools, AI agents and your teams work together in harmony.
ai_context.caption: You're in control while AI assist. The production stays aligned.

script.problem_card_title: This is no longer a tooling problem.

script.shift_card4: Remain authoritative from development through delivery

budget.hero_pill: Production Budgeting Built for Connected Workflows
budget.hero_sub2: A production budget is not just a financial document. It is a living reflection of scope, timing, and creative intent. When it lives in isolation from the script, breakdown, and schedule, alignment breaks. And when alignment breaks, overruns follow.
budget.problem_title: When Budgeting Lives in a Silo,
budget.problem_desc: Traditional budgeting tools are powerful, trusted, and built to support complex productions. But they often operate as standalone systems.
budget.problem_card_title: Financial insight becomes reactive, not timely.
budget.problem_item1: Budgets live in one place while scripts evolve elsewhere.
budget.problem_item2: Schedules adjust in another system entirely.
budget.problem_item3: Information moves manually between files and departments.
budget.problem_right1: As information moves manually between files and departments, clarity begins to fade. Versions multiply, visibility narrows, and financial insight becomes reactive instead of timely.
budget.problem_right2: This is not a spreadsheet problem. It is a coordination problem.
budget.connected_sub: Pzaz Budgeting sits inside the same environment as your script, breakdown, schedule and production workflow, so the financial picture stays connected to the decisions that shape the film.
budget.connected_highlight: One system, with financial clarity built in.
budget.connected_label: Nothing has to be passed between files
budget.connected_item3_result: the financial implications are already visible
budget.shift_desc: When budgeting lives inside the same infrastructure as the rest of production, behaviour begins to change.
budget.shift_b1: Departments send revised files back and forth
budget.shift_a1: Departments work within the same budget
budget.shift_a2: Producers see cost implications before committing
budget.shift_b3: Forecasts catch up to scope changes later
budget.shift_bottom1: The budget stops being a document that explains what already happened.
budget.shift_bottom2: It becomes a tool that helps shape what happens next instead.
budget.features_desc: Rigorous financial control without requiring budgeting to live in a separate silo.
budget.feat2: Configure ledger structures for accountant compatibility
budget.feat3: Build multi-currency budgets for international productions
budget.feat4: Set taxes, fringes, and regional compliance rules
budget.feat5: Create scenario budgets with structured version control
budget.feat6: Track forecasts against actuals in real time
budget.feat7: Attach documents directly to budget line items
budget.ai_desc: AI can generate numbers quickly, but numbers without context rarely run a production. In Pzaz, AI works within the full coordination of your project — not outside it.
budget.ai_card1_desc: Generate structured budgets directly from breakdown data — no manual re-entry between systems.
budget.ai_card2_desc: AI highlights cost patterns and anomalies so financial risks surface before they become overruns.
budget.ai_card3_desc: Support scenario forecasting with structured comparisons across budget versions and schedule changes.
budget.ai_card4_desc: Accountants remain in control. Producers remain responsible. AI adds speed and structure where it helps.
budget.ai_highlight: Clarity improves, and at the same time, judgment stays human.
budget.legacy_p1: Industry-standard tools like Movie Magic Budgeting have earned their place over decades. They provide deep financial logic and are familiar to line producers and accountants across the industry.
budget.legacy_p2: Pzaz does not try to replace that foundation.
budget.legacy_p3: It simply places budgeting inside the wider production environment. Instead of a financial file moving between specialists, the budget stays connected to the script, breakdown and schedule.
budget.legacy_p4: Financial depth should not require complexity. Legacy budgeting systems are powerful, but they often carry the weight of older software — desktop-bound, training-heavy, and difficult to navigate.
budget.legacy_p5: Pzaz keeps the financial discipline, but removes the friction.
budget.legacy_p6: It delivers the same level of control inside a modern, cloud-based environment where producers, department heads, and accountants can work together without barriers.
budget.cta_desc: When budgeting lives inside the same infrastructure as the rest of production, fragmentation begins to disappear. Creative ambition stays connected to operational reality.
budget.cta_bottom: Run your production in sync. Operate with real financial clarity.

storyboard.hero_sub1: Storyboarding is where imagination becomes visible. It is the moment ideas leave the script and begin to take shape on screen.
storyboard.hero_sub2: The faster you can explore, refine, and align around those ideas, the stronger the production becomes.
storyboard.problem_p1: Traditional storyboarding is powerful but slow. Once drawn, boards can become rigid. Iteration takes time. Collaboration happens outside the frame.
storyboard.problem_p2: AI-only tools move fast, but often without continuity or control. They generate options, not direction. Creative teams are left sorting through outputs instead of shaping intent.
storyboard.problem_quote: This is not just a tooling issue. It is a creative workflow issue.

storyboard.feat3_desc: Adjust framing, scale, and camera distance with precision.
storyboard.feat4_desc: Switch between black-and-white and colour outputs to match your creative intent.

storyboard.cta_body: With Pzaz, creative momentum and production structure work together. You explore freely. You refine deliberately. You align naturally.
storyboard.cta_bottom: Edit the film before you shoot it.

planning.hero_sub: From script to schedule, Pzaz Planning Pro gives you a structured, connected pre-production workflow that keeps every department ready and every decision visible.
planning.problem_p1: In most film workflows, writing enjoys a kind of glorious isolation. The draft comes first, planning politely waits its turn, and budget conversations only enter the room once the scope has already stretched itself comfortably beyond financial gravity.
planning.problem_p2: For a while, the script feels complete. Then breakdown begins. Then the arithmetic of reality arrives, and suddenly the elegant creative decisions made upstream turn out to have very practical downstream consequences.
planning.problem_p3: Structural adjustments at that point aren't impossible, but they are expensive — whether emotionally, financially, or politically.
planning.problem_quote: This isn't a failure of imagination. It's a failure of coordination.
planning.context_p1: Planning Pro does something deceptively simple: it keeps the script, the structural breakdown, the early visual thinking and the first signs of execution all in the same conversation from day one.
planning.context_p2: Instead of allowing each discipline to develop politely out of sight of the others, it lets them influence each other while change is still cheap.
planning.context_bold: Preproduction stops being a series of corrective measures and becomes a series of deliberate decisions.
planning.context_b1: Script and structural breakdown evolve in the same conversation from day one.
planning.context_b2: Early visual thinking connects directly to the scenes it affects.
planning.context_b3: Complexity becomes visible immediately — while change is still cheap.
planning.context_b4: Production reality enters the conversation early, not as a surprise.
planning.handoff_p1: Without structure, development tends to culminate in a ceremonial moment: the script is declared "finished," exported, and handed over as if it were a completed object. Only then does production begin the real translation. And it's at that translation stage that misalignment politely reveals itself.
planning.handoff_bold: Planning Pro removes the drama of the handoff entirely.
planning.handoff_point1: Rewrites remain inside a living production context, where structural elements are surfaced as you develop.
planning.handoff_point2: Feedback stays attached to the scenes it concerns.
planning.handoff_point3: Early planning signals emerge while choices are still flexible, not after they've calcified into commitments.
planning.handoff_closing: You're not polishing a document for delivery. You're constructing a production from the inside out.
planning.ai_desc: AI inside Planning Pro has no ambition to outwrite you or out-direct you. Its role is subtler — it pays attention to structure. You lead. The system supports. Creative judgment remains entirely human.
planning.ai_card1_desc: Detects practical elements within scenes and surfaces patterns you may not have consciously noticed.
planning.ai_card2_desc: Supports breakdown preparation before it becomes urgent — operating inside the full context of your project.
planning.ai_card3_desc: Help you explore alternatives without losing the thread of your creative intent.
planning.ai_card4_desc: Not a detached prompt box. It works inside your project, aware of your context, your draft, and your direction.
planning.features_desc: Planning Pro provides a structured environment for writer-directors who are not just drafting a screenplay, but preparing a film to be made.
planning.feat1_desc: Write and revise with scenes that remain live and interconnected rather than drifting into static versions.
planning.feat2_desc: Maintain structured version control that reflects evolution instead of chaos.
planning.feat3_desc: Key production elements are detected as you develop, not weeks later during a frantic breakdown.
planning.feat4_desc: Early visual thinking connects directly to the scenes it affects, so aesthetic ambition and practical implication grow side by side.
planning.feat5_desc: Feedback stays anchored to exact moments in the script, not scattered across emails and documents.
planning.feat6_desc: Your script doesn't move through disconnected stages. It evolves inside one continuous production environment.
planning.features_closing: Each capability reinforces alignment between what you intend creatively and what will be required operationally.
planning.cta_desc: Preproduction isn't administrative overhead. It's the moment where imagination encounters physics, budgets, time, and people. Planning Pro decides to work with them rather than pretend they don't exist.
planning.cta_body: Develop inside production reality, not outside it.
planning.cta_bottom: Build your film before you shoot it — inside the same context that will eventually carry it to set.

task_management.hero_h1a: A Production Doesn't Need More Tasks.
task_management.hero_sub: Film productions are full of moving pieces. Departments preparing equipment, producers coordinating logistics, directors refining creative decisions. Everyone is busy. Yet no one sees the full picture.
task_management.problem_title: Productions don't struggle with having tasks.
task_management.problem_desc: Most productions rely on improvised systems to manage tasks. Each system works on its own. Together, they create confusion.
task_management.problem_card_title: These are the questions no one can answer.
task_management.problem_q2: Is it finished? Has it even started?
task_management.problem_q4: Which version is the right one?
task_management.problem_tools_footer: …and no one is sure which one is current.
task_management.problem_bottom: This is not a productivity problem. It is a coordination problem.
task_management.core_desc: One platform. The complete production task lifecycle. Everything your team needs — from assignment to completion — in one connected workspace.
task_management.core_feat1_desc: Tasks live inside the same environment as scripts and schedules. No separate tool, no context switching.
task_management.core_feat2_desc: Every task has a named owner connected to a real department, not just a name in a spreadsheet.
task_management.core_feat3_desc: Dates reflect actual production timing because they exist inside the scheduling context.

task_management.cta_desc: With Pzaz, you know what needs to happen, who is responsible, and how to keep the production moving forward.

file_sharing.problem_title: Productions don't struggle with having files.
file_sharing.problem_title_highlight: They struggle with finding the right one.

file_sharing.problem_card_title: These are the questions no one can answer.
file_sharing.problem_q1: Which file is the real one?
file_sharing.problem_q3: Where did that reference image go?
file_sharing.problem_q4: Did anyone get the updated script?
file_sharing.problem_tools_footer: …and no one is sure which version is current.
file_sharing.problem_bottom: This is not a storage problem. It is a coordination problem.
file_sharing.core_desc: One platform. The complete production media lifecycle. Everything your team needs — from upload to delivery — in one connected workspace.
file_sharing.core_feat1_desc: Files live inside the same environment as scripts and scenes. No context switching, no disconnected folders.

file_sharing.core_feat4_desc: AI supports visual exploration and asset generation within the project context. Creative direction always stays human.
file_sharing.cta_title: Keep Your Production Library in Sync.
file_sharing.cta_desc: When media storage lives inside the same infrastructure as the rest of production, your files stay organised and your project vision stays clear.
file_sharing.cta_body: Centralise your files. Protect your assets. Keep your production in sync.
